info.title: AttendanceIQ API
info.description: Backend API for the AttendanceIQ punch-in / punch-out attendance platform. See README.md for conventions, roles & scope, error model and data models.

tags.name: Authentication & Profile
tags.description: Sign-in, token refresh, password flows and the signed-in user's own profile. Tokens are JWT bearer tokens: a short-lived **access token** (1 h) sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, and a long-lived **refresh token** (7 d, rotated on every use).

tags.name: Companies
tags.description: Tenants of the platform. Managed by the Super Admin; an Admin can read only their own company.

tags.name: Sub-Companies
tags.description: Branches of a company. **Employees, shifts, holidays and devices hang off sub-companies.** Super Admin manages them; Admin reads all of their company's branches; HR reads only their own.

tags.name: Departments
tags.description: Company-level classification of employees (Engineering, HR, Finance…). One list shared by every sub-company of a company.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: Platform accounts. **Super Admin** manages Admins and HR users anywhere; **Admin** manages HR users inside their own company. HR has no access.

tags.name: Employees
tags.description: People whose attendance is tracked. **An employee belongs to a sub-company, not to the company.** HR is pinned to one sub-company; Admin works across all sub-companies of their company; Super Admin has read-only access.

tags.name: Shifts
tags.description: Work schedules owned by a sub-company. Attendance late / early-out / overtime are calculated against the employee's shift.

tags.name: Holidays
tags.description: Public holidays per sub-company. A holiday date turns everyone's attendance for that day into `HOLIDAY`.

tags.name: Attendance
tags.description: Daily / monthly attendance, manual punch entries and recalculation. **Attendance records are calculated, never posted** — the inputs are device punches, manual entries, the shift, holidays, weekly offs, approved leave and the company attendance settings.

tags.name: Requests & Leaves
tags.description: Regularization, missing-punch and leave requests with an approval workflow: **HR raises → Admin approves/rejects**; requests raised by an Admin are auto-approved. An approved request is applied to attendance (a manual entry, or `ON_LEAVE` days).

tags.name: Devices
tags.description: Biometric punch devices. **Super Admin** registers, edits, allocates, re-allocates and deallocates. **Admin** has a read-only view of the devices allocated to their company. Punches reach the platform through the [Device Gateway](12-gateway.md).

tags.name: Device Gateway
tags.description: Machine-to-machine endpoints called **by the punch devices (or an on-site agent)**, not by the web app. Authenticated with the device's credentials instead of a user JWT. This is how raw punches enter the system; attendance is then calculated from them.

tags.name: Configuration — Attendance Settings
tags.description: Company-wide attendance policy (Configuration → Attendance Settings). Shifts, holidays and departments have their own modules; the branch profile is under [Sub-Companies](03-sub-companies.md).

tags.name: Reports & Exports
tags.description: Excel / PDF / CSV exports of attendance. Today the UI only simulates these with a timer; this defines the real thing. Small reports finish inside the request; large ones return `202` and are polled.

tags.name: Dashboards
tags.description: Pre-aggregated data for each role's landing page. All figures are computed from live data — nothing here is hand-maintained.

tags.name: Activity Logs
tags.description: Immutable audit trail of every state-changing action (create, update, delete, activate, allocate, approve…). **Written by the server** from the authenticated request — clients never post log entries. Super Admin only.

post.description:
Exchange email + password for tokens and the user profile. Replaces `authService.login`.

**Used by:** LoginPage

**Access:** Public (no auth)

- After **5 failed attempts in 15 minutes** the account/IP is locked for 15 minutes (`429 TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS`).

- The frontend stores `token` as `auth_token` and `user` as `auth_user` in localStorage.

value.message: Signed in successfully
Invalid email or password

403.description: User account is deactivated / User's company (or sub-company) is deactivated

value.message: Account is inactive. Contact your administrator.
Your company is inactive. Contact the platform administrator.
One or more fields are invalid
Too many failed sign-in attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.

post.description:
Get a new access token (and a rotated refresh token) without asking the user to sign in again. Call this from the axios 401 interceptor **before** redirecting to `/login`.

**Used by:** axios interceptor (`src/lib/axios.ts`)

**Access:** Public (no auth)

- Each refresh token is single-use. Re-using an already-rotated token revokes the whole token family (theft protection).

refreshToken.description: The refresh token issued at login / last refresh.

401.description: Refresh token expired / Refresh token invalid / already used / revoked

value.message: Session expired. Please sign in again.

value.message: Invalid refresh token
One or more fields are invalid

post.description:
Revoke the refresh token so the session cannot be resumed. Replaces `authService.logout`.

**Used by:** Topbar → Sign Out

**Access:** Super Admin, Admin, HR

- Always succeeds for an authenticated caller; logging out twice is not an error.

refreshToken.description: Refresh token to revoke. If omitted, all of the caller's sessions on this device are revoked.

value.message: Signed out successfully

isActive.description: Exactly one active allocation per allocated device.

DeviceAllocation.description: One entry in a device's allocation history. Re-allocating or deallocating closes the active entry and keeps it.

deviceId.description: Device id, or `MANUAL` for hand-entered punches.

date.description: The attendance date this punch belongs to (an overnight shift's OUT keeps the start date).

PunchRecord.description: A single IN/OUT punch. `punchTime` is the **wall-clock time in the sub-company's timezone**, ISO-8601 without an offset.

punchRecords.description: Device punches plus any manual punches, oldest first.

breakMinutes.description: Gaps between an OUT and the next IN.

lateMinutes.description: Minutes after `start + grace`. 0 if on time.

overtimeMinutes.description: Minutes past shift end when ≥ overtime threshold and overtime is enabled, else 0.

status.description: See the status rules in the Attendance module.

isManual.description: True when a manual entry contributes punches to this day.

leaveType.description: Set when the day is covered by approved leave.

AttendanceRecord.description: One employee-day, **calculated** from raw punches + shift + attendance settings. Never written directly; recalculated whenever inputs change.

overtimeMinutes.description: Total overtime minutes across the records.

DailyAttendanceStats.description: Aggregate counts for a set of daily attendance records.

date.description: Attendance date, or first day of leave.

punches.description: `[{ punchIn, punchOut }]` as `HH:mm` (empty string when only one side is supplied).

leaveDays.description: Working days covered (weekly offs and holidays excluded).

AttendanceRequest.description: A regularization, missing-punch or leave request. **The Requests/Leaves UI is currently commented out in the frontend; the API is specified for when it is re-enabled.**

balances.description: `{ CASUAL, SICK, EARNED: { total, used, pending }, UNPAID: { used, pending } }`. Remaining = `total − used − pending`.

LeaveBalance.description: Leave entitlement and usage for one employee and year.

lateGracePeriodMinutes.description: Default grace for **new** shifts; each shift keeps its own value for late calculation.

earlyOutThresholdMinutes.description: Buffer before shift end before an early leave counts.

minimumWorkingHours.description: `HH:mm`. Stored; not yet applied to status calculation.

overtimeThresholdMinutes.description: Minutes past shift end before overtime starts counting.

autoAbsent.description: Reserved: auto-mark absent after midnight. Stored; not yet applied.

AttendanceSettings.description: Company-wide attendance policy. Changing it recalculates attendance.

module.description: Companies, Sub Companies, Devices, Users, Employees, Shifts, Holidays, Attendance, Requests, Configuration.

ipAddress.description: Client IP taken from the request.

ActivityLog.description: Immutable audit-trail entry. Written by the server for every state-changing request.

filters.description: The filters the report was generated with.

ReportJob.description: A generated export. Small reports complete synchronously; large ones return `PROCESSING` and are polled.
